description_expanded: This redesigned vacation rental residence in Blue Mountain Beach exudes charm and exemplifies the very best of a chic South Walton lifestyle. It is located just south of Scenic 30A, a short stroll away from the neighborhood beach access that leads down to the glittering Gulf. However you don't have to go much beyond the back door in order to have a refreshing dip since this hospitable home comes with its own private pool. On Point is a true vacation compound that is perfect for mixed families or groups of friends since it has a separate Guest House and may accommodate a total of up to 16 happy beach going guests. The architectural design seamlessly dovetails a rustic cozy look with state of the arts modern amenities and creature comforts. It is simultaneously casual and sophisticated with comfortable furnishings. Unique decorative art and vibrantly colorful seascapes adorn the walls throughout. There are full kitchens in both the main house and guest house with separate living space for leisurely lounging. Gleaming stainless steel appliances and large granite topped kitchen islands in each one come with multiple stools for dining, drinking and snacking. The main house has double glass doors that open out onto the sparkling pool, which is literally steps away. You will all find yourselves wanting to spend a lot of time here when you're not down on the beautiful beach. There is an outdoor Tiki Cabana Bar with seats, a stainless steel gas grill and a Wet Bar. This allows you the pleasure of enjoying favorite drinks and a fun family feast poolside. A Fire Pit is available for use beside the seasonally heated pool for occasionally chilly nights. Rich multi-toned hardwood flooring flows throughout the interiors with matching wall accents. A large flat screen TV is provided in the main living area for entertainment while new wall mounted TVs are in each bedroom. Each of the five bedrooms is individually decorated in a charming cottage style for laid back living. The Primary Bedroom has a full luxury bath en suite with two raised square sink vanities, a soaking tub in an alcove as well as a walk-in shower with magnificent marble tile work completed in creams and grays. Sleeping accommodations include a king size bed in the Primary Bedroom, queen size beds in two Guest Bedrooms along with a queen sized Futon and queen sized sleeper sofa. The Guest House has a queen size bed, a twin day bed with a twin trundle, and another queen sleeper sofa in the living room. Blue Mountain Beach itself has a claim to fame as being the highest elevation found along the entire Gulf of Mexico. The sugary white beach here has been awarded a prestigious "Blue Wave" designation, which is the nation's highest standard for natural beauty and cleanliness. There is a Health Food Spa nearby along with a few restaurants, a bakery and an ice cream shop. This locale in the heart of the wonderful world of Scenic 30A in South Walton and is minutes away from many restaurants, beach bars, galleries, free concerts and seasonal festivals in other picturesque coastal villages along this route. Main House: First Floor:  Living Room with Queen Sleeper Sofa, Kitchen with Bar Seating, Powder Room, Laundry. Second Floor:  King Master Suite with Walk-In Shower and Garden Tub, Queen Bedroom with Tub/Shower Combo, Queen Bedroom, Den with Queen Futon, Full Hall Bath with Tub/Shower Combo. Guest House: First Floor:  Living Room with Queen Sleeper Sofa, Kitchen with Bar Seating, Full Hall Bath with Tub/Shower Combo, Laundry. Second Floor:  Queen Bedroom, Twin Day Bed + Twin Trundle. *add $50.00 per day to heat pool (available Oct-April if needed)
